freelance.description: Open-source i18n tooling, SharePoint document management for a law-firm system, this portfolio, and an open-source dashboard of Germany’s electricity market.
highlights: Built and published @tuhama/translation-manager, an open-source npm package for managing i18n keys with AI-assisted translation.
Built this portfolio in Next.js 16 in English, Arabic, and German, tested with Vitest and deployed through GitHub Actions.
Built SharePoint document management (Entra ID sign-in, Microsoft Graph) and data tables for a Qatari law firm’s case management system, now in production testing.
Building Stromblick, an open-source dashboard of Germany’s electricity market: React 19, Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL in a TypeScript monorepo.
Work AI-first: rule and skill files encode project standards, AI reviews every change, and agents never get production credentials.

bpro.description: Led frontend development of an enterprise ERP aimed at large companies in the Gulf region: a 150,000-line React and TypeScript codebase, held alongside the government role.
highlights: Frontend lead and architect for 4+ years: set the architecture and coding guidelines, reviewed every pull request, and mentored four junior developers.
Designed the design system that more than half of the 1,300+ module files build on, across 12 ERP modules.
Built the data layer with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, tested with Jest and Cypress.
Built granular role-based access control, from permission screens to filtered routes and navigation.
Built a custom PDF report engine on jsPDF that renders QtRPT XML report templates.
Cut rendering time of 10,000-row reports by 80% with pagination and list virtualization.
Integrated frontend builds into Jenkins CI/CD with Gitea for automated branch deployments.
